inputs.checklistItemText: Existing or future dedicated easements not shown on one or more sheets (BAS-12)
inputs.question: Are easements (such as utility easements, public easements, or drainage easements) shown on this sheet? Look for easement lines, labels, or hatching indicating easement areas.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether easements are present and visible on the sheet at all (a feature/element presence check), not whether easement boundaries are dimensioned, measured, or spatially related to other features. This is sheet-level feature discovery, not drawing annotation inspection or clearance measurement.
